ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this"Agreement"), made as of October 21, 2013,by and among MARCO MOURA,and ANGELA MOURA,each having an address at 155 East 4"h Street, Apt. 16G, New York, New York 10009 (collectively, “Parcel A Owner") and QUEENSBORO DEVELOPMENT LLC, having an address at 22-60 46"h Street, Astoria, New York 11105 ("Parcel B Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Parcel A Owner is the owner of certain real property in Queens, New York, known as and by the street address 41-09 23rd Street, Long Island City, New York, Block 413, Lot 20 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Queens County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Parcel A"; and, together with any building or improvements placed thereon hereinafter referred to as the“Parcel A Property"); and WHEREAS, Parcel B Owner is the owner of certain real property in Queens, New York, known as and by the street address 41-03 23rd Street and 23-02 41s Avenue, Queens, NY, and designated as Block 413, Lots 22 and 27 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Queens County, and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter collectively referred to as “Parcel B" and, together with any building or improvements placed thereon hereinafter referred to as the "Parcel B Property"; Parcel A and Parcel B are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"); and WHEREAS,Parcel A Owner andParcel B Owner have entered into a Contract of Sale dated February 3, 2011 ("Contract of Sale"), pursuant to which Parcel A Owner intends to sell to Parcel B Owner Parcel A, and Parcel A and Parcel B shall be merged into a single tax lot; and WHEREAS, the Parcel B Owner intends to construct a new building (the “Parcel B Building") of approximately 118,950 square feet in the aggregate, which shall consist of approximately 84,000 square feet of residential apartments and related facilities, approximately "Project");and WHEREAS, the proposed Parcel B Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use under the floor area ratio limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution") as it relates to Parcel B as an independent zoning lot,with theresult thatParcel B Owner and theParcelA Ownerdesire to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for declaring Parcel B and Parcel A a single zoning lot for the purpose of causing the Parcel B Building to comply with the limitations contained in the Zoning Resolution. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.o0) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties heretoagree asfollows:
